Forest staff attacked by encroachers in Madhya Pradesh, several injured

In Madhya Pradesh's Khandwa district, forest department personnel on patrol were attacked by encroachers. The attackers used stones, sticks, and axes, resulting in injuries to over ten forest staff. A case has been registered against 15 individuals, including eight named suspects.
